messages:
anya_csm: FYI Renewal ~32d. Their monthly active usage dipped ~61% (480 -> 187). Champion moved to data team last week and hasn't responded.

infra-bot: Automated alert: acct_vestiforms usage -61% (30d) vs baseline. Alert ID: UDA-20260610-42.

mike_ae: thanks. procurement hinted they ran a quick demo with "SlipForm" last month. Any telemetry showing platform errors or dropped webhooks?

cal_se: onboarding checklist stuck at 58% (most items around webhook validation + sample payload mapping). I see bursts of 502/504 and several 429s during their nightly sync. Snippet below:```
2026-06-10T02:12:03Z WARN 502 /v1/webhook acct=vestiforms req=sync-73
2026-06-10T02:12:04Z ERROR 504 /v1/webhook acct=vestiforms req=sync-74
2026-06-10T02:12:59Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate acct=vestiforms pid=gw-21
```

anya_csm: that sync is critical for their billing ingestion job. If callbacks failed overnight, they likely saw incomplete records and paused usage.

mike_ae: can infra confirm if retries/backfill happened? If the failure was on our side we need to offer remediation and signal credit. If it's their endpoint, help them finish integration.

cal_se: looking now. Initial check: gw-21 shows elevated 429s during window; webhook proxy returned 502 in several retries. I'll correlate with client-side health pings. ETA 3h.

talia_manager: two-track plan: (1) technical triage + backfill if we caused failures; (2) re-engage new PM with an adoption workshop & short commercial incentive to lock renewal. Prioritize triage.

anya_csm: suggested outreach template: "Hi P

 noticed a drop in activity and Sam's role change. Can we do 30m to review integration and blockers? We can assign SE hours to finish validation and provide a short remediation credit if failures were on our side." Approve?

mike_ae: approve. Offer: 12 SE hours + $4k credit for a 6mo renewal, hold exact terms pending root cause.

cal_se: action items: I'll produce a short log summary and indicate whether backfill is needed (ETA 3h). If failures are on our side, we'll run a recovery job and a remediation note for the customer.

infra-bot: Reminder: create renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_vestiforms, renewal_32d)  ticket #RW-20260610-88

anya_csm: created SF ticket RW-20260610-88 and linked to onboarding-rescue playbook. Scheduling provisional triage call for tomorrow; will update thread after cal's scan. :white_check_mark:

mike_ae: I'll ping procurement and see what SlipForm demo covered (features, timeline). If they did a feature-for-feature eval, prep counterpoints (latency, data controls, dedicated SE).

cal_se: log summary: primary issue is gateway throttling (429) for short window and webhook proxy returning 502 on retries. No sign of billing disputes. Recommend immediate: increase soft-throttle for acct_vestiforms, run backfill for missed callbacks, and schedule SE session to finish webhook validation.

anya_csm: great. I'll coordinate SE session and share the remediation note with the new PM. Updating SF RW-20260610-88 with action items. We'll reconvene here after the triage call. :eyes:
